items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1961-08-15
items.q: So, I went to old man John, I'm afraid of taking lessons from him. And I found I was making some slow improvement with him. And I left him and went to Dave Poikins.

ctx.x: I happened to meet one of his brothers over in Bordeaux, France. Well, he had one of John's old clarinets and just had it laying up there. And I told him, I said, well, you got that horn, why don't you give it to me? You ain't using it. For sure enough, he did. And I took John's clarinet and kept it on the boat, fooling around with it, you know, in my spare time. And I came out the Navy 1921, 1920. And I played around here a while. And then finally I decided I'd take lessons and try to learn it right, you know?…
That was on the clarinet, did you say?
